comment: Independent C-first recipe for save.c saveobjchn() and restore.c restobjchn() handling of svc.context.victual.piece. Wizard-mode map and teleport put the hero on the down staircase, where she drops a wished lichen corpse and starts eating it from the floor. A hostile grid bug created next to her interrupts the meal, leaving victual.piece on a floor object. Descending saves the level, which nulls the pointer; ascending restores it by o_id, so eating the corpse again resumes the meal.
